summary: Small dual-path dispatcher on the selector at this+0x10 (DWORD index 4). When it is non-zero, StringLengthDispatch is called with the pointer stored at this+0x0 and the input string, returning true when the result differs from -1. Otherwise StringWriteToFile is called with the input string and the value at this+0x0, again returning true when the result differs from -1. Structural twin of ConditionalDispatch_6bd0 (00566bd0).

local_names.this: dispatcher object holding a selector and a string/stream value

operations.description: Branches on the selector at this+0x10 (DWORD index 4): non-zero takes the string-length dispatch path, zero takes the file-write path
StringLengthDispatch called with the pointer stored at this+0x0 and the input string; success is a result other than -1
StringWriteToFile called with the input string and the value stored at this+0x0; success is a result other than -1
Returns true when the selected path produced a result other than -1, false otherwise
Used as a lookup/write helper by four callers: LinkedListDispatchWithVTableCalls, FileStreamCleanup, SettingsIniFileWriter and PlayerOpponentStateWriter

unresolved: The meaning of the selector at this+0x10 (interpreted as an existence test selecting lookup versus write) is inferred from the two call paths, not proven
Whether the value at this+0x0 is a string pointer, a stream handle or an internal buffer is not determined by this packet
